controls.close_by_swap: exact subject/object swap with predicate unchanged; absolute compatibility difference
controls.support_contact_endpoint_swap: prohibited; no blanket transform without exact predicate inverse and geometry rule
controls.vertical_inverse_equivariance: exact subject/object swap plus higher<->lower; absolute compatibility difference
controls.wrong_T_on_GT_relative_vertical: GT relative_vertical rows only; endpoints and raw G fixed; higher/lower predicate inverted; aligned interactions recomputed
controls.wrong_pair_geometry_continuity: GT rows only; replace raw G by the next lexicographic directed pair in the same subgraph under a cyclic shift; keep T fixed

default.implementation: semantic ranking_score multiplied by family_specific compatibility
default.selection: theory-driven frozen default; internal-dev may only accept or reject it

docker_command: env UID=$(id -u) GID=$(id -g) docker compose -f configs/h001/compose.yaml run --rm train_only_execution_freeze

evaluation.candidate_policy: actual candidate count only; no synthetic padding
evaluation.context_inclusion: all contexts; GT presence never used for ranking/filtering/routing

rank_fusions.rank_average_family: 0.5*(within-context semantic percentile + within-context family compatibility percentile)
